text_block_list.text:
The spring of Эль Кондор Паса's classic
year has
ended, and summer camp
season is here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Realizing she can't just stay depressed,
she
decides that if she has to be worried,
it's better to
worry cheerfully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A bright and exciting summer begins
with Mambo
close behind!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
